subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: It is often said that our large population is our number one problem. (a) ----- it is not true. (b) -----, large population can be turned into a unique manpower in a country. (c) ----- China can be cited. (d) ----- her population is more than 160 million, she is progressing day by day. (e) ----- we are lagging behind.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) But; (b) In fact; (c) In this connection; (d) Though; (e) Unfortunately.
